definitions: Plans or courses of action taken to achieve a particular purpose.
Units used to express the size, amount, or degree of something.
Musical notation indicating a group of beats between two bar lines.
examples: The government introduced new security measures.
We need to take all necessary measures to prevent the spread of the virus.
The recipe calls for precise measures of ingredients.
The conductor asked the orchestra to repeat the last two measures.
The measure was passed by a narrow margin.
